result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the bottom navigation bar has a serious layout defect: the home indicator (gesture bar) is rendered horizontally across the center of the tab bar, overlapping the search icon and the bookmarks/orders icon, making those tabs look broken and likely hard to tap. Other elements (partially visible carousel items and the cut-off pizza card at the bottom) are expected scrolling behavior and not defects.

issues.description: The device home indicator (horizontal gesture bar) is drawn across the middle of the bottom tab bar, overlapping the search and bookmarks icons. This makes the navigation bar look visually broken and can interfere with tapping those tabs.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding (e.g. respect the home-indicator inset) so the tab bar content sits above the gesture bar, or move the tab icons up and add a transparent spacer at the very bottom.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right has a small red badge dot with no numeric count or label, which may be unclear to screen-reader users and offers no information about what the notification is.
issues.suggestion: Provide an accessibility label such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' and consider showing a count or ensuring the badge is announced by assistive technology.
